First, note the date format is DD-MM-YYYY: 12-08-1263 means 12 August 1263.  
230 days later:  
August has 31 days → from Aug 12 to Aug 31 is 19 days.  
230 − 19 = 211 days left.  

September (30 days) → 211 − 30 = 181 left.  
October (31) → 181 − 31 = 150 left.  
November (30) → 150 − 30 = 120 left.  
December (31) → 120 − 31 = 89 left.  
January 1264 (31) → 89 − 31 = 58 left.  
February 1264 (leap year? 1264 divisible by 4 → yes, 29 days) → 58 − 29 = 29 left.  
March (31) → 29 − 31 = −2 → means March 31 − 2 days = March 29, 1264.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1264-03-29
